public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC28 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Exact RC26 recovery, exact accepted RC24, retained exact historical routes and genuine fresh installation; failed RC27, modified and unknown sources fail closed.

simulation_safety: Disarmed-only browser state; armed/unknown/stale/disconnected state discards it, disarm does not reactivate it, and refresh/reconnect/reboot clear it; no flight-controller state is written.
